subject: Kickoff - VHH design workflow as our sequence-design reference
body:
All,

Starting the VHH design workstream. The open-source release covers high-throughput ML-guided design of diverse single-domain antibodies against SARS-CoV-2 - notebooks for the data, the plots, and critically a model that scores candidate sequences, the same one used to design the third library.

We are not going into antibodies as a business. What I want is the workflow: propose, score, select for diversity, measure, feed back. That loop is the reusable asset, and today every sequence-design conversation here restarts from zero.

Mar 2 - Jun 1:
- Mar 27: notebooks running against our infra, scoring reproduced on the released third-library sequences.
- Apr 30: diversity-selection step reimplemented as a standalone library with our own distance metric.
- May 26: internal write-up + one design round on a non-antibody sequence problem.

Bruno on resourcing, Gustavo tech lead. Deliberately small team - this is a study, not a product.

Anders
